description: Loop node body — an ordered cycle of oriented edge references forming a closed boundary.

Reversed.description: True: traverse from End → Start (i.e., reversed)

BrepOrientedEdge.description: One oriented use of an edge within a loop.

BrepRef.description:
Relative- or absolute-path reference to another Brep topology node, wrapped in
angle brackets (USD relationship-target syntax). `../` ascends one segment
relative to the referencing node's composed path; a leading `/` is absolute.
Examples: "<../Edge_3>", "<../Vertex_0>".
